policy: MercadoLibre BBP (hackerone.com/mercadolibre) — policy snapshotted via h1sync 2026-08-30 + live scope table rendered 2026-08-31 (73 assets). Gold Standard Safe Harbor, managed by HackerOne. RESTRICTIONS (law): massive automated scans NOT permitted (creative testing encouraged; human cadence observed); improper/out-of-scope use of test users may ban; no service degradation; no spam; no compromising other users' accounts. FEATURE EXCLUSIONS: Melidolar (all), KYC (non-monetary actions without identity validation), GraphQL with DoS impact, Collaborators (all). Core Ineligible Findings out of scope. CVSS >= 2.0 only. Bounty: T1 high $7,000-8,900 / crit $9,000-10,000 (+RCE/ATO tables). Scope captured live via browser scout (.tmp/h1-scope-scout.json) — Tier tags preserved in .tmp/meli-assets.json raw rows.
